completion_data.completion_summary: Deleted skill-team-research, skill-team-plan, and skill-team-implement from the source store after de-referencing 19 other files (22-entry file_scope total); zero-hits grep confirmed over both the source store and the redeployed .claude/ tree, with run-all.sh (57/57), all four reference/routing lints, and check-task-references.sh all green. Fixed a real index-entries.json line_count drift this task introduced; the two other verify-deploy.sh failures (doc-lint, validate-state.sh --deep) were confirmed pre-existing and unrelated.

memory_candidates.content: deploy-headless.sh's default mode is additive-only and detect-never-delete: after removing a skill/file from manifest.json's provides and deleting its source, a plain redeploy will NOT remove the now-orphaned copy already present in .claude/ -- verify-deploy.sh's whole-tree orphan detection (gate 13, find_orphans) will keep failing until a --wipe full destructive resync runs. --wipe is safe whenever .claude/ is gitignored/untracked (confirm via git check-ignore first). When a task deletes or renames a source-store file, plan for a --wipe redeploy as part of its own verification, not just the default resync.

Editing prose/doc files under agent-system/extensions/<ext>/context/** changes their line counts, which silently desyncs agent-system/extensions/<ext>/index-entries.json's declared line_count field -- check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R (via verify-deploy.sh gate 3) then fails doc-lint. The sanctioned fix is `bash .claude/scripts/generate-context-line-counts.sh --write` (run from the DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/ tree, not the source store -- it errors if run from agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ directly). Caution: this script recomputes ALL extensions' index-entries.json in one pass, so if any other extension has a pre-existing unrelated mismatch, --write will also 'fix' that file as a side effect outside the task's own file_scope -- check `git diff --stat` afterward and consider reverting any out-of-scope file before committing.

git-commit-scoped.sh cannot stage a pathspec that has already been fully staged for deletion (e.g. via a prior `git rm -r`) when the path no longer exists on disk: its V2 unmatched-pathspec safety gate checks `[ -e "$p" ] || git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$p"`, and `git ls-files` (index-scoped) no longer lists a path once its removal is staged, so the check treats it as unmatched and V3 refuses the commit (zero positive pathspecs). Workaround for this one case: acquire/release the commit mutex directly via `task-lock.sh commit-acquire`/`commit-release` around a plain `git commit`, after confirming via `git diff --staged --stat` that only the intended deletions are staged.
